1479-2841-3678-8104.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Misty Rainforest.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
1479-2841-3678-8104.description:
Fetch a land using Misty Rainforest.
When the fetched land enters, Retreat to Emeria and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Retreat to Emeria trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Emeria from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Retreat to Emeria triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

339-677-7297-8095.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1170-4908-5131-6495--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-4908-5131-6495--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Enthusiastic Mechanaut.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the artifact, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evereth
Repeat.
1170-4908-5131-6495--202.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

1020-2866-4659-7058--175.description:
Announce the activation of Barrels of Blasting Jelly's first ability.
During this activation, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks four times by sacrificing Scrap Trawler, Myr Retriever, Barrels of Blasting Jelly, and the zero-mana artifact, adding six {C}.
Continue activating and resolving the Barrels of Blasting Jelly ability, causing you to pay {1} and adding {1}.
Scrap Trawler triggers four times and Myr Retriever triggers once.
Resolve the Scrap Trawler trigger from the 0 cost artifact, returning nothing to your hand.
Resolve the Scrap Trawler trigger from Barrels of Blasting Jelly, returning the 0 cost artifact from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Scrap Trawler trigger from Myr Retriever, returning Barrels of Blasting Jelly from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Scrap Trawler trigger from itself, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Myr Retriever trigger, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast the 0 cost artifact by paying {0}.
Cast Barrels of Blasting Jelly by paying {1}.
Cast Myr Retriever by paying {2}.
Cast Scrap Trawler by paying {3}.
Repeat.
1020-2866-4659-7058--175.notes: This combo works by taking advantage of the fact that you can activate mana abilities during the declared activation of an activated ability. This allows you to delay putting the Trawler and Retriever triggers on the stack (and selecting their targets) until both permanents are in the graveyard. For more information, please see rules 605.3, 602.2b, and 601.2g.

1368-1563-3499-6321.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1368-1563-3499-6321.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

3175-3967-4775.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Necrogen Communion triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Necrogen Communion from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

147-2438-7364.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
147-2438-7364.description:
Cast Continue? by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Continue?.
Holding priority, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Continue?
Resolve the Continue? copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
147-2438-7364.notes: You can sacrifice up to three additional creatures and return them using Continue? each loop.

1257-3259-3756--85--106.notablePrerequisites: An opponent is unable to block and kill creatures you control.
1257-3259-3756--85--106.description:
Activate Walking Atlas by tapping it, putting Izzet Boilerworks from your hand onto the battlefield.
Izzet Boilerworks enters the battlefield, triggering itself and the permanent with a landfall ability.
Resolve the Izzet Boilerworks trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the landfall trigger, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage to an opponent with the creature that has Breath of Fury attached.
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to and then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token from step 4, untap all creatures you control, and get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

240-413-4068-5470.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Mountain.
240-413-4068-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
When the Egg enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
When the Egg enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 5, dealing 1 damage to any target
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

When Drakestown Forgotten dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

When Wispweaver Angel enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

1456-4668-5078.description:

Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.

3459-5078-6650-6723.easyPrerequisites: The Lunar Whale has attacked this turn.
3459-5078-6650-6723.description:
Activate Battered Golem by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Battered Golem triggers, untapping Battered Golem.
Repeat.

3446-3532-4928-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Forgotten Ancient triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

Activate Urza by paying {6}, targeting Radiant Lotus.
Locus of Enlightenment triggers, copying Urza's ability, targeting Radiant Lotus.
Resolve both Urza abilities, creating two token copies of Radiant Lotus that are 1/1 Soldier artifact creatures.
Activate a Radiant Lotus token by tapping it and sacrificing both Radiant Lotus tokens, targeting yourself.
Locus of Enlightenment triggers, copying the Radiant Lotus token's ability, targeting yourself.
Resolve both Radiant Lotus abilities, adding twelve mana of any color.
Repeat.

869-1987-3980-4423.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary and Sisay's Ring by tapping them, adding {C}{C}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Sisay's Ring.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

2246-3657-4893-6726.description:
Cast Ruby either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {0} due to Bard Class plus commander tax, if applicable.
Activate Ruby by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Kogla by paying {G}, returning Ruby from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
2246-3657-4893-6726.notes: If Bard Class is level 3, you will also exile your library with the ability to play the exiled cards until end of turn.

1846-5702-5954-6664.easyPrerequisites: Springheart Nantuko attached to Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
1846-5702-5954-6664.notablePrerequisites: Overlord of the Hauntwoods does not have summoning sickness.
1846-5702-5954-6664.description:
Cast High Tide by paying {U}.
Declare Overlord of the Hauntwoods as an attacker.
Overlord of the Hauntwoods triggers, creating an untapped Everywhere land token due to The Wandering Minstrel.
When the Everywhere token enters the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers.
Holding priority, activate Everywhere by tapping it, adding {G}.
High Tide triggers, adding {U}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When the Overlord of the Hauntwoods token enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a tapped Everywhere land token.
Repeat from step 4.

1082-4050-4499-6521.manaNeeded: {1}{W} if a Hare Apparent is in your hand or {3} otherwise, plus {1} if you do not control another Hare Apparent
1082-4050-4499-6521.description:
If you have a Hare Apparent in your hand, cast it by paying {1}{W}. If not, activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking a Hare Apparent.
When Hare Apparent enters the battlefield, it and Dual Nature's first ability trigger.
Resolve the Dual Nature trigger, creating a token copy of Hare Apparent.
When the Hare Apparent token enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Rabbit creature tokens equal to the amount of other creatures you control named Hare Apparent.
Resolve the Hare Apparent trigger from step 2, creating a number of 1/1 Rabbit creature tokens equal to the amount of other creatures you control named Hare Apparent.
Activate Phyrexian Altar up to three times by sacrificing up to three Rabbit tokens, adding up to {3}.
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking a nontoken Hare Apparent.
Hare Apparent, Dual Nature's first ability and Dual Nature's second ability trigger.
Resolve the first Dual Nature trigger, creating a token copy of Hare Apparent.
Repeat from step 4.
1082-4050-4499-6521.notes: You should not resolve the Dual Nature second ability triggers. This allows you to continually get more and more Hare Apparents, allowing you to make more Rabbits each iteration. Eventually, once you have infinite Rabbits, you can then stop the combo, sacrifice Rabbits and infinitely blink creatures as desired.

2511-3394-6249--5.notablePrerequisites:
Weatherlight Compleated has at least six phyresis counters on it.

2511-3394-6249--5.description:

Resolve the Weatherlight Compleated trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the persist creature's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, Olivia triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and causing you to discard a card.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

433-2979-4543.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least one land card in hand.
Patchwork Crawler does not have summoning sickness.
Trench Behemoth and Llanowar Scout exiled by Patchwork Crawler.
433-2979-4543.description:
Activate Patchwork Crawler using Llanowar Scout's ability by tapping it, putting a land from your hand onto the battlefield.
If the land is mana-producing and enters the battlefield untapped, you may activate it by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Patchwork Crawler using Trench Behemoth's ability by returning the land from the battlefield to your hand, untapping Patchwork Crawler.
Repeat.

2092-3301-4131.notablePrerequisites:
Tezzeret has at least two loyalty counters on it.
Basalt Monolith does not have summoning sickness.
2092-3301-4131.description:
Activate Tezzeret's second ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing Basalt Monolith to become an artifact creature.
Activate Basalt Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Basalt Monolith's last ability by paying at most {2}, untapping it.
Repeat from step 2.

495-500-3129-4688-4751.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to kill Nested Shambler.
495-500-3129-4688-4751.description:

When the Verdurous Gearhulk tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, putting at least nine +1/+1 counters on Nested Shambler, and the remaining 23 +1/+1 counters on any creature(s) you control.
Kill Nested Shambler, triggering its ability, creating at least twenty 1/1 Squirrel creature tokens.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Epic Struggle triggers, causing you to win the game.

2114-3258-4170.notablePrerequisites:
Ayara's Oathsworn and Fain do not have summoning sickness.
Ayara's Oathsworn has exactly three +1/+1 counters on it.
An opponent cannot block Ayara's Oathsworn.
2114-3258-4170.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Ayara's Oathsworn.
Ayara's Oathsworn triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and searching your library for Beacon of Tomorrows and putting it into your hand.
Activate Fain's second ability by tapping it and removing a +1/+1 counter from Ayara's Oathsworn, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Cast Beacon of Tomorrows by paying {6}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one, and shuffle Beacon of Tomorrows into your library.
Repeat each turn.

618-2816-4813.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent has lost life this turn.
Umbral Mantle attached to Kiki-Jiki.
618-2816-4813.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Famished Foragers with haste.
When the token Famished Foragers enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Activate Kiki-Jiki by paying {3} and untapping it, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.

2209-4659-5003.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Ancient Stone Idol, adding {C}{C}.
Ancient Stone Idol dies, triggering itself and Nim Deathmantle.
Resolve the Ancient Stone Idol trigger, creating a 6/12 Construct artifact creature token.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Construct, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger from step 2, causing you to pay {4} to return Ancient Stone Idol from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Repeat.

4776-5147.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
4776-5147.description:

Sprouting Phytohydra triggers, creating a token copy of itself.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the damaged Sprouting Phytohydra, dealing 1 damage to the remaining Sprouting Phytohydra.
Repeat from step 2.

1651-2034-2382-2648.description:
Activate Mimic Vat by paying {3} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Phyrexian Triniform with haste.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Phyrexian Triniform token, adding {C}{C}.
The token Phyrexian Triniform dies, creating three 3/3 Golem artifact creature tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping two Golems, untapping Mimic Vat.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Golem, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

1371-1827-3765-4838.description:
Cast Vampiric Tutor by paying {B}.
Hive Mind triggers, causing each opponent to create a copy of Vampiric Tutor.
Holding priority, cast Worldfire by paying {6}{R}{R}{R}.
Hive Mind triggers, causing each opponent to create a copy of Worldfire.
Resolve each Worldfire on the stack, exiling all permanents, all cards in all hands and graveyards, and setting each player's life total to one.
Resolve the first opponent's copy of Vampiric Tutor, causing them to search their library for a card, put it on top of their library and lose 2 life.
The opponent loses the game due to having less than zero life.
Repeat from step 6 for each remaining opponent.

3313-3858.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power nine or greater.
3313-3858.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Mayael's Aria triggers, causing you to put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control and gain ten life.
At the beginning of your end step, Lathiel triggers, putting ten +1/+1 counters on a creature you control with power ten or greater.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Mayael's Aria triggers, causing you to put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control, gain ten life and win the game.

2050-3525-4878.notablePrerequisites:
Pemmin's Aura attached to Arbor Elf.
Market Festival attached to a Forest you control.
2050-3525-4878.description:
Activate Arbor Elf by tapping it, untapping the enchanted forest.
Activate the Forest by tapping it, adding {U}{G} and one mana of any color.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Arbor Elf.
Repeat.

364-813-1987-4792.description:
Activate Paradise Plume by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Paradise Plume and Scholar of the Ages, blinking them as well as triggering Paradise Plume to gain you 1 life.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
When Paradise Plume enters the battlefield, choose "blue".
Repeat.
